summary: Mobile parity retest — ALL 8 checks PASS. (1) Plan & Billing portal FIX verified: mobile now POSTs to /api/payments/portal (not /api/portal). For cathy who has no stripe_customer_id, backend returns 400 and the UI shows the friendly 'No Stripe customer on record. Start a subscription first.' banner — NO red 'Not Found' error. (2) Signup plan picker renders both plans, selection toggles correctly ('Start 7-day free Family/Solo trial' text swaps), helper copy 'We take your card securely on Stripe' is present, participant/seat counts render. (3) plan-select shows plan-participants-solo='1 PARTICIPANT TRACKED', plan-seats-family='UP TO 5 CAREGIVER SEATS', plan-current-family badge (cathy is on family), and plan-subscribe-solo (cathy is not trial-eligible so shows Subscribe not Trial — expected). (4) DD/MM/YYYY dates verified: Plan & Billing 'Renews 01/01/2027', Audit Log timestamps '16/08/2026 08:28', Referrals '16/08/2026'. Zero long-form ('23 August 2026') or short-form ('23 Aug 2026') dates observed on tested screens. (5) Audit Log renders 112 rows with audit-row-* testIDs, actions, actors, DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm timestamps. (6) Referrals: add-btn opens form, submit creates 'Dr Lee' specialist referral as referral-row-0 with referral-status-0/referral-remove-0 present, status cycles OPEN→IN PROGRESS on tap. (7) Contribution Position: all six testIDs (ce3-lifetime-cap-card, ce3-annual-card, ce3-annual-estimate, ce3-reconciliation-card, ce3-reconcile-btn, ce3-cap-refresh) render for cathy's active participant. (8) Drawer parity: navGroups.ts confirms Referrals, Audit Log, and Contribution Position are all implemented:true (live links) and Support is the only intentionally-hidden entry (no implemented flag) — verified in /app/mobile/src/config/navGroups.ts.
critical_code_review_comments: Portal path fix in /app/mobile/app/plan-billing.tsx:69 is correctly '/payments/portal' now — matches backend and web behavior.
